question: Sanjiv Ranjan assumed the role of secretary general of the which of the following organisation on January 1,2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IORA (Indian Ocean Rim Association)**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__
 
• **Sanjiv Ranjan**, a seasoned diplomat, assumed the role of **Secretary General of the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA)** on **January 1, 2025**. 
• The **Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA)** is an intergovernmental organization that promotes regional cooperation and sustainable development within the Indian Ocean region. 
• The IORA was established in **1997** and comprises **23 member states** that share a coastline along the Indian Ocean, including countries such as India, Australia, South Africa, and Indonesia. 
• The role of the Secretary General involves overseeing **policy implementation, fostering cooperation** among member states, and facilitating dialogue on issues such as maritime security, trade, and disaster risk management.
